# Printex Engineers

> Supplier of genuine printing press spare parts, based in Nairobi, Kenya.
> Parts include valves, cylinders, bearings, grippers, and other components
> for printing press machinery.

Printex Engineers sells printing press spare parts online. Customers can
browse the catalogue, check live stock and pricing, and place orders for
delivery or pickup from our Nairobi workshop.

## Site structure

- Home: /
- Full product catalogue: /products
- Individual part pages: /products/{part-slug} — each includes the part
  name, price in KES, description, and current stock status.
- About: /about

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prices shown on the site are in Kenyan Shillings (KES) and include the
  parts currently in stock at our Nairobi location; pricing and stock
  levels change and should always be read live from the page rather than
  cached.
- /cart, /checkout, /login, /register, and everything under /admin and
  /account are session-specific or access-restricted pages, not public
  reference content — please don't index or summarize their contents as
  general information about Printex Engineers.
- For current business details (address, contact, hours), refer to the
  /about page or the structured data (schema.org/Store) present on every
  page, rather than assuming details from this file, which covers site
  structure only.
